summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 150th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 24, 2026. The meeting approved routine proposals: a year-end dividend of 100 JPY per share, election of directors including Julie Kim and Paul Stoffels, election of audit committee members, a substitute director, and director bonuses. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, delisting, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no deal mechanics or special situation elements.
